name: odsh-bridge
description: OpenClaw x DeepSeek Harness bridge: gateway WebSocket client (Ed25519 pairing) + file-based envelope daemon. Zero dependencies, pure ESM. Optional SQLite audit store requires Node >=22.5 (node:sqlite); core bridge runs on >=18.

scripts.check: node --check src/env.mjs && node --check src/gateway-client.mjs && node --check src/oc-invoke.mjs && node --check src/oc-send.mjs && node --check src/oc-client.mjs && node --check src/oc-cua.mjs && node --check src/bridge-daemon.mjs && node --check src/dshtrigger.mjs && node --check src/sqlite-store.mjs && node --check src/sqlite-impl.mjs && bash -n scripts/setup-dsh.sh && bash -n scripts/dsh-entrypoint.sh && bash -n scripts/new-bridge.sh && echo ALL_SYNTAX_OK
